backing.collateral_ratio_basis: Accountable-reported total_reserves over yzUSD supply ONLY. ⚠️ The denominator excludes the yzPP and yzPRIME books, which have their own liabilities and their own ratio (collateralization_rwa). Reproduced from the published fields each run; if it stops dividing, the basis changed.
backing.surplus_deficit_basis: total_reserves - yzUSD supply, the same basis as the ratio

alternatives.note: ⚠️ Three readings of one reserve, and the spread is the point. The rated ratio divides by yzUSD supply alone and counts yzPP as cushion. ex_junior_tranche_pct removes it — yzPP is first-loss capital, but it is third-party money redeemable on a 30-day window, so the cushion can leave. over_all_yuzu_supply_pct divides by every product's supply against the same reserve. None is wrong; they differ in which liabilities the reserve is asked to cover.

peg.note: Market price from coingecko against the $1 peg target. ⚠️ 24h volume is $6,291.92 — a deviation struck on this little turnover is weak evidence about fair value and strong evidence about exit cost. Both readings belong.

liquidity.total_2pct_depth_note: No executable ladder is quoted for yzUSD; depth is unmeasured rather than zero. ⚠️ But the finding does not need one: 24h volume is $6,291.92 across 1 swap venue(s) holding $800,699. TO ESTABLISH A LADDER: a quote path on curve-dex (Plasma). ⚠️ For syzUSD this stays absent deliberately: only the SMALLER of Monad's two pools has been laddered by anyone, and the unmeasured $374,780 pool is 3.5x it — a depth number built on the $108K pool would measure 22% of the venue and be read as the asset.
liquidity.pools_note: Swap venues only. ⚠️ Lending markets are listed under asset_specific.lending_exposure: they are the larger numbers and they are a liquidation-risk fact, not a peg fact — a venue that cannot quote the asset cannot price it.
liquidity.by_chain_note: Swap, lending and issuer-vault TVL per chain, all from the same DefiLlama enumeration so the three are comparable. ⚠️ A chain with vault TVL and NO swap venue has no local exit — the aggregate cannot say that. ⚠️ And this is DefiLlama's view of the chain set: riskAnalyst read syzUSD satellites on Pharos and Berachain that DefiLlama does not list, so the chain count here is a FLOOR, not a census. Vault TVL is also not the same quantity as mirrored supply read on-chain; the two are close but must not be mixed.

primary_exit.gated_note: Redemption reachability is not probed in v1. ⚠️ Unmeasured, not open.

upstream.note: ⚠️ CIRCULAR: yzPP is first-loss capital whose own value is a claim on the strategy book it cushions, so it stops being a cushion precisely when the book takes losses. dependencies.by_protocol_note: ⚠️ 16 rows, 9 named protocols. Legs sharing a bracket prefix are ONE counterparty. Concentration is already flagged on the grouped figure (>25% of backing), which is why Ethena at 35.25% carries a flag — but Maple at 20.67% across three rows is the second-largest exposure in the book and sits UNDER that threshold, so nothing marks it and no adjacency in the row order suggests adding them.

surplus_denominators.note: ⚠️ `x_surplus` divides by the RATED surplus, which is ~90% yzPP — junior third-party capital redeemable on a 30-day window. `x_surplus_ex_junior` divides by the senior's own cushion. Both are published because the gap between them IS the finding, and a single multiple would have to pick one silently. No threshold is set on either — see exceeds_ex_junior_cushion below for how many protocols would trip one today. ⚠️ THERE IS NO CUSHION AT ALL RIGHT NOW: removing the junior tranche leaves the senior UNDER-COVERED by $2,049,296. `x_surplus` divides by a surplus that is junior money; the senior's own coverage is NEGATIVE, so no exposure has a meaningful multiple against it and the field is null rather than large.

risk_flags.message: RECURSIVE BACKING: $3,065,021 (5.3% of backing) is Yuzu's own yzPRIME, whose own ratio is 1.004395
LEVERAGE: $45,706,468 (78.6% of backing) sits in looped positions — a collateral ratio on a levered book is not that ratio on spot

CONCENTRATION: Ethena exposure $30,866,574 (53.1% of backing), ~11.2x the $2,760,761 surplus — and there is NO EX-JUNIOR CUSHION: removing yzPP leaves the senior UNDER-COVERED by $2,049,281, so the surplus this multiple divides by is entirely junior money that can redeem on a 30-day window

NO LOCAL EXIT: at least $9,626,395 of vault TVL sits on 2 chain(s) with no swap venue — Ethereum, Sei. ⚠️ A LOWER BOUND: this enumerates DefiLlama's chain list, which omits satellites read directly on-chain (Pharos, Berachain), so the true stranded total is higher. The aggregate liquidity figure is not available to these holders
UNTRACKED CHAIN: DefiLlama reports $9,284,947 of SYZUSD vault TVL on Sei, a chain absent from our records — either a deployment we do not track or a mislabel, and we do not know which
SETTLEMENT GAP: yzUSD supply is on Plasma, but only $4,815,729 of $58,180,108 backing (8.3%) is — the rest must move cross-chain to meet a redemption
EX-JUNIOR BELOW PAR: removing yzPP's $4,810,042 of first-loss capital leaves 96.30% against yzUSD supply — the headline surplus is that tranche's money

corroboration.note: Feed figures reproduce the chain. This pairing is the only thing between this dashboard and republishing an issuer's self-reported number unchecked.

asset_specific.exposure_note: exposure_split is a snapshot at exposure_as_of while total_reserves is live, so the difference is DRIFT and grows with the table's age. Never derive total_backing from it. reserves_split (by chain) is a different field and DOES sum to total_reserves exactly.

unknowns: quorum_denominator: m_threshold is 4 OF AN UNSTATED TOTAL — the feed carries no signer count, so 4-of-5 and 4-of-25 are indistinguishable from this payload
default_action 'block': the payload does not say what is blocked, nor whether it applies on failure to reach quorum or to unrecognised calls
verifiability '100': a string with no declared scale, and no statement of whether it is measured or asserted
governance.note: ⚠️ Pass-through from the issuer's Fordefi policy, NOT measured here. Published with its unknowns named so a renderer can show '4-of-unknown' rather than inferring a denominator. TO ESTABLISH THE DENOMINATOR: the Fordefi policy's signer set, which is not in this feed — it needs the issuer's own governance disclosure or an on-chain read of the safe.

asset_specific.wallets_note: Published by the feed; balances are not queried in v1.

history_window.note: Range is over the last 30 days (940 points), NOT the whole file — the export retains 400 days and a full-file range is roughly twice as wide, which makes a step look like noise. reserve_step_* count numerator-only moves >1% in the same window; the per-run flag clears the next hour while the level persists, so this is the durable form.
